sentence: This project builds a method that lets engineered systems combine slow measurements from different sensors to respond quickly and reliably.
This project studies driven quantum matter and searches for materials that show exotic quantum phases, such as superconducting and magnetic ones.
This project builds tools that combine gene and protein data with tissue stiffness to study how a preservative chemical affects the uterus.
This project estimates the flow depth and slope of ancient rivers in the western United States to test where their sediment came from.
This project builds statistical models that estimate where species live and how many there are while accounting for errors from artificial intelligence classification.
This project builds a computer pipeline that automatically identifies unknown biomolecular structures in cryo-electron tomography images of cells.
This project studies extra copies of genes in the sunflower family to find out how they control plant growth and development.
This project uses deep learning to find cracks and draining lakes on the Greenland Ice Sheet and studies how meltwater reaches its bottom.
This project builds mathematical methods from graph theory and differential geometry to understand how biomolecular structure relates to function.
This project uses a regional climate model to study how climate change affects small areas of the Pacific Northwest, including flooding and wildfire risk.
This project builds a method using neural networks and physics to interpret piezocone tests and estimate soil properties.
This project builds methods that let manufacturing facilities share design data for patient-specific bioengineered products while protecting sensitive patient data.
This project holds a conference on Hamiltonian geometry, which uses symmetries to describe physical principles such as conservation of energy and momentum.
This project studies how sea stars make proteins that bind to ice and how this changes with season and temperature.
This project tries to make cardiac cells grown from human stem cells more mature using a chip and machine learning.
This project holds a symposium where researchers share advances in understanding and developing materials with unique quantum properties.
This project designs quantum algorithms that resist noise by building error protection into the algorithm itself.
